title: Rabbi Yissa bei Rabbi Shabtai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Gittin.9.7.2). Hyman proposes that the text should read “Rabbi Yissa in the name of Rabbi Shabtai.” He points to [Bava Batra 163a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.163a.3), where Rabbi Shabtai gives a ruling in the name of Chizkiyah, and to [Gittin 26b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.26b.2-3) as a parallel.[^1]

notes.text: The Jerusalem Talmud retains beRabbi, in a discussion measuring the gap by the witnesses’ signatures. Bava Batra concerns the measure of two lines in the witnesses’ handwriting. Gittin likewise has Shabtai reporting Chizkiyah, but there the stated reason concerns a quarrel.
